corrections.why: The Register's last visit (11/26/22) describes a tower on private property, but Tennessee Landforms marks it removed with no date. Neither source settles the current state, so 'standing' is not confirmed.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR records a 2022 site visit but does not describe the tower's condition; Tennessee Landforms marks it removed without a date. Left as unknown rather than picking one.

notes_for_editor: Status is the open question. A current visit or a dated source would settle it. The Register's 'Privately Owned' line is the only ownership statement. Height 45 ft converted to 13.7 m. No build date, builder, staffing or fire record was found. The countyoffice.org directory mentions a Waynesboro tower, but it returned 403 and was not used. Access level 'private' follows the Register.
